title: Pure geometric fibres give the ordinary pointwise fibre dimension
statement: Let $g:T\to B$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and let $d\in\mathbb N$. Suppose every nonempty geometric fibre of $g$ [def-weil-geometric-fibre] is pure of dimension $d$ [def-weil-pure-dimension]. For $x\in T$ put $s=g(x)$, write $T_s=T\times_B\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ for the ordinary fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre], and identify $x$ with its point in $T_s$. For an algebraic closure $\Omega=\overline{\kappa(s)}$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], put $T_{\bar s}=T\times_B\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$, with projection $p:T_{\bar s}\to T_s$. Then there exists $\bar x\in T_{\bar s}$ with $p(\bar x)=x$, and every such point satisfies $\dim_x(T_s)=\dim_{\bar x}(T_{\bar s})=d$, where both dimensions are local topological Krull dimensions [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point], not the Krull dimensions of the local rings. In particular $\dim_x(T_{g(x)})=d$ for every $x\in T$. No flatness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 00P4 (lemma-dimension-at-a-point-preserved-field-extension), combined with Varieties Tag 0A21 (lemma-dimension-locally-algebraic), parts (3),(5); extracted geometric-to-ordinary fibre argument from lem-trf-dth-fitting-smooth-locus, original proof Step 2, serving the geometric-fibre version of Divisors Tag 0C3K.

proof.text: Mathlib directly supplies local finite type from local finite presentation (FinitePresentation.lean, the LocallyOfFiniteType instance, using finite presentation implies finite type on affine charts). Apply stability under base change to obtain local finite type for the ordinary fibre Y = T_s over k = κ(s), and then for Y ×_{Spec k} Spec Ω over Ω.

The geometric-fibre identification gives $T_{\bar s}=Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ with projection $p$. The field-extension map $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is surjective. Its base change $p$ is therefore surjective, so the given $x\in Y$ has a lift $\bar x$. In particular $T_{\bar s}$ is nonempty, and the purity hypothesis applies to it.

source.place: Tag 01S1 (lemma-base-change-surjective); the spectrum of a field has one point

proof.text: Apply fibre_dimension_after_base_change to the ordinary-fibre structure morphism Y → Spec k and the field-extension map Spec Ω → Spec k. This compares local dimensions in their fibres at every point of the displayed pullback. For any scheme over a field, its fibre inclusion over the unique base point is an embedding whose image is the whole scheme, by fiberHomeo. It is therefore a homeomorphism. Transport local dimension by identifying open neighbourhoods through this homeomorphism, both for Y and its field extension. This yields dim_x Y = dim_xbar (Y ×_{Spec k} Spec Ω) for every lift xbar of x.

Surjectivity supplies a point xbar of the geometric fibre, so hpure applies and every irreducible component has dimension d. The top open of this fibre is homeomorphic to its underlying space; pull irreducible components back through the inverse homeomorphism and transport their dimensions. Apply topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_of_equidimensional_open over Ω to this top open, obtaining dimension d at every geometric-fibre point. Combine this with the comparison in Step 3 for each lift, and use the lift from Step 2 for the final ordinary-fibre equality.

lean.statement: theorem geometric_pure_fibre_point_dimension {T B : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ B) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g] (d : ℕ) (hpure : ∀ (s : B) (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (B.residueField s) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (B.residueField s) Ω], Nonempty ↥(pullback (g.fiberToSpecResidueField s) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (B.residueField s) Ω)))) → (pullback (g.fiberToSpecResidueField s) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (B.residueField s) Ω)))).IsPureDimension d) (x : T) (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (B.residueField (g x)) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (B.residueField (g x)) Ω] : (∃ xbar : ↥(pullback (g.fiberToSpecResidueField (g x)) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (B.residueField (g x)) Ω)))), pullback.fst (g.fiberToSpecResidueField (g x)) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (B.residueField (g x)) Ω))) xbar = g.asFiber x) ∧ (∀ xbar : ↥(pullback (g.fiberToSpecResidueField (g x)) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (B.residueField (g x)) Ω)))), pullback.fst (g.fiberToSpecResidueField (g x)) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (B.residueField (g x)) Ω))) xbar = g.asFiber x → topologicalKrullDimAt (g.asFiber x) = topologicalKrullDimAt xbar ∧ topologicalKrullDimAt xbar = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) ∧ topologicalKrullDimAt (g.asFiber x) = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)
